newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks seen lower after U.S. declines.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks seen lower after U.S. declines.

text.p: AUD US$0.7378 (Friday US$0.7438) CRB Index cl 243.36 +0.61
*Stocks seen opening weaker in quiet trade after U.S. declines on Friday. "It'll be quiet because of the bank holiday," said Peter Struk of Reynolds & Co in Sydney.
*Wall Street finished mostly lower as investors were startled by sharp upturns in U.S. payrolls and manufacturing activity.
*ADRs: News Corp 18-3/8 (-1/16), BHP 26-5/8 (-3/16), WMC 22-3/4 (-11/16), National Australia Bank 72-3/8 (-5/8)
*Gold price was higher. Base metal prices were mixed with copper lower, nickel higher.
